paper_claim: SemanticSync provides a complete relational CRDT convergence proof for SQLite databases
test_or_artifact: Not tested; theoretically impossible for arbitrary relational transactions
required_revision: Revise to: provides schema-assigned pairwise merge policies for tracked SQLite columns in enumerated schedules; does not claim a general CRDT convergence proof

paper_claim: Explicit numeric INCREMENT operations are distinct from absolute SET/UPDATE assignments and preserve additive intent
required_revision: Retain claim scoped to tracked explicit-increment operations; contrast clearly with historical state-based SET assignments

paper_claim: State-based conflict detection with SUM policy achieves 97.50% to 98.25% SCR on synthetic stress workloads
required_revision: Explain that shortfalls occur when independent concurrent writes arrive at identical non-base values, which state diffing treats as clean identity rather than conflict

paper_claim: Generic LWW achieves 0% SCR under the additive workload oracle
required_revision: Clarify that 0% SCR reflects an intentional semantic mismatch against the additive arithmetic oracle (base + deltaA + deltaB), not general computational failure of LWW

paper_claim: Benchmark row-value agreement (RVAR) reaches 100% across all tested benchmark rows
test_or_artifact: All 18 stress trials and all 90 increment trials
required_revision: State explicitly that RVAR measures equality of the ordered bench_rows.value vector between replicas; it is not proof of full-database or whole-schema convergence

paper_claim: Valid Resolution Accuracy (VRA) is measured and reported across scaled synthetic stress workloads
required_revision: Report VRA as N/A or unmeasured for synthetic workloads lacking business/range validation rules; never claim a synthetic VRA percentage

paper_claim: SemanticSync achieves lower synchronization overhead than application-level merges
required_revision: Clarify that SemanticSync batch synchronization took longer than the application_sum baseline across all 90 trials (positive delta median 449 ms to 84.4 s), reflecting metadata logging, receipt tracking, and causal validation overheads absent in the naive baseline

paper_claim: Foreign-key quarantine protects every SQLite write across the entire database lifecycle
evidence_strength: Supported by implementation inspection but not comprehensively tested
required_revision: Scope claim: applies to engine-tracked parent DELETE operations and received replay deletes; direct uninstrumented SQL writes bypass engine quarantine checks

paper_claim: Orphan quarantine is non-destructive and supports reliable child re-linking
required_revision: Retain claim; document that child payloads are preserved as JSON in _ss_quarantine and status transitions occur only upon successful resolution

paper_claim: Compaction safely prunes the causal log using stable horizon checkpoints
evidence_strength: Tested only on selected inputs or paths
required_revision: Retain claim but note boundaries: single-process coordination lock, manual review required for RESOLVE-tail conflicts, and uncertified power-loss durability

paper_claim: The nine-configuration increment evaluation proves general multi-replica mesh convergence
required_revision: Revise to: verifies pairwise synchronization across 90 reproducible executions of two replicas; does not establish arbitrary N-way mesh convergence or concurrent writer interleavings

paper_claim: The benchmark workloads simulate concurrent multi-writer contention
required_revision: Explicitly state that benchmark workloads execute sequential tracked local writes followed by a single batch synchronization; they do not simulate concurrent writer contention
